Actual semantic result searches and accessible earlier claims provided no covering result; novelty remains subject to undetected equivalent literature.

value.rationale: The exact graph condition resolves a motivated limitation of qualitative network-polarization simulations. It classifies all supported sign patterns for arbitrary finite contact networks at strong homophily, gives a precise minimum connected size of four, and demonstrates stability even with permanently positive cross-cutting ties. The quantitative finite-beta error bound has direct dynamical meaning; not a cosmetic reformulation of a small graph example.
